answer: A lotus only blooms in still water, so quiet clusters are suspect. Each identity must anchor to shale laid by two distinct holders outside its own bed, and one anchor cannot support two identities, so relaying it merges the claims. Every anchor is sealed with a relic whose origin is public, and the k-th saint seal an operator files costs k squared in bond, making n aliases pay near n cubed while still needing n unrelated cosigners. A replica whose relic resolves to a shared funder is voided, and relics cannot be sold or lent.
